reader.requirement: At --std 85, a MOVE whose sending or receiving operand is a group (any non-elementary move, including a literal, figurative constant or elementary item into a group and a group into an elementary item of any category) must copy the sender's characters as an alphanumeric-to-alphanumeric move, left-aligned, truncated or space-filled on the right, with no conversion of representation, no sign stripping and no editing, ignoring subordinate items and their JUSTIFIED clauses; except (VI.5.8.4 GR3) that a group containing an OCCURS DEPENDING ON uses its current-count part as a sender and when its object is outside the group, and its maximum length as a receiver whose object is inside it.

edition-consulted.switches: the per-edition SR5 figurative-constant-to-numeric rows; a group receiver is exempted (FigurativeAssociation.Sr5ReceiverOf) at every edition, so a group move never reaches the edition row
level1985 = DialectLevel < 2002: the width and scale of an ALL digit literal moved to an ELEMENTARY numeric receiver; not on the group path (a group receiver of ALL literal takes EmitGroupMove)

reader.edition-search: grep -n 'Edition|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior|ConstructRegistry|DialectLevel' over MoveClassifier.cs, MoveEmitter.cs, PlaceRenderer.cs, OperandText.cs, ReceivingStore.cs, OdoModel.cs, PlaceBuilder.cs: one hit, MoveEmitter.cs:678 in AllLiteralNumber (elementary numeric receiver only); VersionConformancePass#GateMove is the only validation arm on MOVE. UsesCurrentExtent (dir == Sending || !DependingInside) has no edition test; 1985 GR3 and the later GR8 agree.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (the ODO direction law of 1985 VI.5.8.4 GR3 is the same as the later edition's; the only edition arm on MOVE is the elementary ALL-literal-to-numeric width)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb430 covers RENAMES THRU groups, the overpunched sign kept in a group receiver and packed bytes not converted; pb202 covers the ODO direction via ref-mod; pb3563 RENAMES numeric leaf characters. Not exercised by them: group-to-group truncation/padding, group to numeric elementary (space fill), SIGN SEPARATE senders, figurative constants and ALL literals to a group, a numeric literal to a group, JUSTIFIED subordinates ignored, and the ODO receiving max-length with the object inside.

reader.notes: MoveClassifier routes any group operand to EmitGroupMove/EmitGroupToElementaryMove, which copy the sender's storage image through the representation codec with no conversion; PlaceRenderer#UsesCurrentExtent is the single ODO direction law and matches 1985 GR3 exactly. Every probe class printed what the 1985 text requires; the overlapping MOVE G6 TO G6(2:) is undefined and was not judged.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR3-GR5 and §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR2-GR3; the 2023 OCCURS text carries the same receiving-maximum rule, so the single PlaceRenderer#UsesCurrentExtent law is not a later edition's arm leaking into 85. Probe s4/m1.cob at --std 85, aimed at receivers the reader did not try (an elementary receiver whose own alignment or editing would show whether the move is handled as alphanumeric to alphanumeric): group 'AB7' to X(6) JUSTIFIED RIGHT J1=[   AB7] (alphanumeric alignment of GR4a, as GR5 says); to alphanumeric edited X(2)BX(2) J2=[AB7  ] and numeric edited ZZ9.99 J3=[AB7   ] (no editing: the move is alphanumeric to alphanumeric); to A(5) JUSTIFIED RIGHT J4=[  AB7]; to 9(5) J5=[AB7  ]; S9(4) COMP -2 into a group redefined as COMP J6=-0002 (binary image moved, no conversion); overpunched S9(3) -12 through a group into S9(3) J7=-012 (embedded sign byte moved as a character); X(10) into a 3-char group J8=[012] (right truncation) and back J9=[012       ] (space fill), group into JUSTIFIED J10=[   012]. All match the reading that the receiver is aligned as an alphanumeric item and never edited. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR5; OK §1985:VI.6.19.4 GR4a; OK §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR3b.
